title: [FMLA 10] VoltageGain — Voltage Gain
summary: Decibel voltage gain between input and output.

body.text: Calculator scroll name: VoltageGain. Decibel voltage gain between input and output.
Voltage gain in decibels is a compressed way to write a ratio. A ratio of 10 is 20 dB; a ratio of 100 is 40 dB. If Vout is smaller than Vin, G is negative (a loss).

body.caption: Example: Vin = 0.1 V, Vout = 1 V. The output is 10 times the input, which is 20 dB.

body.title: How to run
items: Press FMLA, then 1, then 0 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
Output E′ = 30 V, input E = 12 V

body.label: Units
body.text: Vin and Vout in the same voltage unit (E′/E > 0). G is in dB. A ratio below 1 gives negative gain (a loss).
